bzip2 / libbzip2 1.0.8

Source: https://sourceware.org/pub/bzip2/bzip2-1.0.8.tar.gz
Archive SHA256: ab5a03176ee106d3f0fa90e381da478ddae405918153cca248e682cd0c4a2269

The original library sources are preserved without modification in third_party/bzip2.
The application's bounded TAR parser and asynchronous N-API bridge are separate code.
The library is used only to import user-selected offline TTS model archives.
The complete upstream license is included in LICENSE.txt in this directory.
